note: Split formats only. 'regular' = the phase before the cut. 'groups[].rounds' = matchdays played inside that group, not total. 'threshold' = where the table is cut and on what points rule. Leagues that are not actually split carry "split": false and their real structure in 'note'.

leagues.quote: In the first phase, teams face each other once in a single-leg tie, after which the league splits into two groups. Phase two features a championship group for the teams finishing first to sixth and a relegation group for teams placed seventh to twentieth.
leagues.points_quote: "(Note: Clubs qualified for this phase with the full regular season points they got, but without goals for or against)" - 2025-26 championship-round table rules, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025%E2%80%9326_Egyptian_Premier_League
leagues.note: Confirmed 2026-27 shape (20 clubs, 19-round single round-robin, 6/14 split); the previous season ran 21 clubs with a 7-team championship stage. Group rounds (5 and 13) are derived, not stated: the 2025-26 championship stage was rounds 22-28 for seven clubs, i.e. one single round-robin, and 14 clubs cannot play a double round-robin inside the calendar. Neither the regular-season end nor the split dates for 2026-27 are published (infobox: '21 August 2026 -'); in 2025-26 the championship stage finished on 20 May 2026 and the relegation stage on 29 May 2026.

leagues.quote: in the first stage the 16 participating teams played each other twice (once at home and once away) for a total of 30 matches, and teams were sorted according to their placement into two hexagonals and one quadrangular group for the final stages. ... Teams carried over their first stage records to the final stages.
leagues.window_quote: "The championship and relegation hexagonals began on 18 and 20 September and are scheduled to end on 13 December, whilst the Copa Sudamericana group was played from 19 September to 7 November 2026." and "The first stage began on 20 February and ended on 14 September 2026."
leagues.note: Not Apertura/Clausura: one table, then a three-way split. This is also not the old 'two stages plus a final' - in 2026 the champion is simply the top of the championship hexagonal (Independiente del Valle clinched with four rounds to go on 8 November 2026), with no final match. The 4-team middle group was cut from six clubs for 2026.

leagues.threshold: top 6 / bottom 6 of the 12-club double round-robin; half of first-phase points, a half point rounded up
leagues.quote: Teams play each other twice (22 matches), before the league is split into two groups of six (the top six and the bottom six), where each team plays the other teams in their group twice (10 matches). Teams carry over half their point tally from the first phase into the second phase.
leagues.points_quote: "Each club carries over half of the points it accumulated during the first phase, with a half point rounded up to a full point."
leagues.note: The article contradicts itself: its Format prose still says 'the top four teams enter the championship group, while the bottom four enter the relegation group', which is left over from 2025-26 (that season really did use a 4-team championship group and a 3-team relegation group after Bourj withdrew) and cannot fit 12 clubs. The table note above, the 10-match second phase and the template's split6 flag all point to 6+6, which is what is recorded here. Season 8 October 2026 - 12 April 2027; the split date between them is not published.

leagues.after: no final; top 3 plus Wellington Phoenix Reserves enter the separate National Championship phase, whose top 2 play a single Grand Final
leagues.quote: 32 clubs compete in the competition, with four qualifying from the Northern League, three qualifying from the Central League and two qualifying from the Southern League for the National Championship phase. Auckland FC Reserves and Wellington Phoenix Reserves qualify automatically for the championship phase.
leagues.note: Not a split of one league. The Central League is a 10-club regional qualifying league (18 rounds, 28 March - 29 August 2026) that feeds 3 clubs + Wellington Phoenix Reserves into the National Championship - a separate 11-club competition, single round-robin of 10 matches, September to 13 December 2026, from zero points, top two to the Grand Final (one match). Reserve sides cannot play the Grand Final. No relegation in 2026.

leagues.note: Not a split of one league: 12-club regional league, double round-robin (22 rounds, 21 March - 29 August 2026) whose top four qualify for the separate 11-club National Championship (single round-robin, September - 13 December 2026, points start at zero, top two to a single Grand Final). Auckland FC Reserves qualify automatically and cannot be relegated; no relegation in 2026.

leagues.note: Not a split of one league: 10-club regional league, 18 rounds, 21 March - 12 September 2026 per the section infobox (the 24 February fixtures release said it would end on 30 August), top two into the separate 11-club National Championship (single round-robin, September - 13 December, zero points, top two to the Grand Final). No relegation in 2026.
